verdict.rationale: Official NVIDIA product page confirms capacity (32GB) and memory type (GDDR7), and independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) corroborate the exact bus width (512-bit) and bandwidth (1.792 TB/s) for this specific card. All four required memory specs are documented across first-party and community sources. Missing for 10: a single first-party spec table listing bus width and bandwidth explicitly (currently only community-sourced).
